_comment: Doctor config for this brain (SPEC 5.3). Tunable values only, no logic, no absolute paths: write ${ROOT}-relative paths where a path is needed. Every key names its reader in _readers; a key that nothing reads is dead config, and the Doctor reports it. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_derived: Not keys any more, derived from the pointer: root, stateDir (<brain>/state), recordsDir (<brain>/records), the root settings paths (<root>/.claude/settings.json + settings.local.json) and the fence log path (%USERPROFILE%/.claude/fence-log.txt).

_readers.schema: doctor.ps1 - must be 1; a mismatch is the MIGRATE finding
_readers.surveyStrict: report.ps1 - when true, SURVEY findings of severity fail turn the verdict RED (exit 1)
_readers.maxDepth: repos.ps1 - how many folders deep to look for .git under root
_readers.excludePathParts: repos.ps1 - a repo whose path contains one of these is not swept at all
_readers.archivedPathParts: repos.ps1 - a repo whose path contains one of these is listed but not judged
_readers.ownerRemotePatterns: repos.ps1 - a remote URL containing none of these is FOREIGN
_readers.frozenPaths: repos.ps1 (frozenDirty finding) / enforcement.ps1 (soft_deny count) / hooks/guard.ps1 (path deny)
_readers.unversionedMaxDepth: repos.ps1 - how deep the no-git-at-all sweep walks
_readers.unversionedIgnorePathParts: repos.ps1 - folders deliberately outside git; add one only with a reason written next to it
_readers.secretExceptions: repos.ps1 (tracked secret scan) / hooks/guard.ps1 (staging and write rules) - absolute or ${ROOT}-relative file paths
_readers.acceptedExceptions: doctor.ps1 - (path, kind) pairs that are reported but not counted; each needs since and reason
_readers.entryPointSnapshots: doctor.ps1 - live file vs byte snapshot, compared after CRLF->LF
_readers.lawClaim: tools/vcs/law-claim.ps1 (the commit check, VCS-23) - extraFiles: more repo-relative paths that count as law files; trailer: the waiver line's name; minReason: shortest reason accepted
_readers.categories: survey.ps1 - folders: top-level folders under root that hold projects; a repository under any other first folder is reported as outsideCategory (never the root, the brain or the root .claude folder). since: ISO date; a stray born before it is reported, one born on or after it is a fail. Empty folders: the check is off
_readers.splitLines: hooks/guard.ps1 rule 6 (file-size) - a source write that leaves a file over this many lines asks (DES-03); 0 disables
_readers.sourceExtensions: hooks/guard.ps1 rules 5 and 6 - which extensions count as source for the manifest and size rules; docs, config and data are not source
_readers.stopDocs: hooks/stop.ps1 - file names that count as documents for the Stop card (DES-07); anything under a docs/ folder counts too

_acceptedExceptionsExample.reason: Vendored third-party tree. Not my work; nothing of mine is lost if it goes. Kinds: noRemote, foreignRemote, shallow, unpushed, frozenDirty, emptyRepo, noGitattributes, noGitAtAll, trackedSecret.
